Services

Temporary staffing

Cover project peaks and skill gaps with independent engineers and specialists, engaged on a project basis.

  1. Home
  2. Services
  3. Temporary staffing

The challenge

When you need this

  • A project peak

    A new contract or a tight deadline needs more engineering capacity than your team has, for a limited time.

  • A specialism for one phase

    A project phase needs expertise you don’t need permanently, such as a security assessment or the commissioning of a line.

  • A key person away

    Long leave or a sudden departure leaves a gap that can’t wait for a permanent hire.

  • A permanent search under way

    You are hiring for the role, and the work can’t stop in the meantime.

What we do

Our approach

Engineering work rarely arrives at a steady pace. A new contract, a regulatory deadline or a sudden departure can leave a project short of the skills it needs, for weeks or months rather than for good. Temporary staffing covers that gap with independent professionals.

We work with freelance engineers and technical consultants who run their own business. For each project we agree the scope, the deliverables and the expected duration, assess candidates with engineers who know the discipline, and introduce a small number of professionals for you to choose from.

The engagement is defined by the project, not by a seat to fill. The professional delivers the agreed work independently, and we stay in touch with both sides until the project closes.

What you receive

  • A project brief with the scope, deliverables, competences and expected duration
  • Independent professionals whose technical skills have been assessed by our engineers
  • A project-based engagement with a defined scope, agreed before work starts
  • Follow-up with you and the professional during the project

How it works

Steps and typical durations

  1. 01

    Project brief

    We agree the scope, the deliverables, the competences needed and the expected duration of the project.

    Typical duration
    2–3 working days

  2. 02

    Search and vetting

    We look for freelance engineers and technical consultants and assess their skills and project experience.

    Typical duration
    1–2 weeks

  3. 03

    Proposal

    You meet a small number of vetted professionals and choose who to engage.

    Typical duration
    3–5 working days

  4. 04

    Project work

    The professional delivers the agreed scope independently, under a project or consulting contract.

    Typical duration
    3–6 months

  5. 05

    Review and close

    We check in during the project and at its end, and help you plan what comes next.

    Typical duration
    1 week

Perspectives

What it means for each role

For HR leaders

  • Flexible capacity for a defined project, without adding permanent headcount.
  • Engagements built around a scope and deliverables, not open-ended staffing.
  • Professionals who run their own business and work independently on the project.

For technical leaders

  • Vetted specialists who can contribute to your project quickly.
  • Expertise for one project phase without making a permanent hire.
  • Cover for leave or departures while you plan the long-term solution.

For experienced engineers

  • Project work in your discipline, as a freelancer with your own business.
  • Scope, duration and rate agreed clearly before the project starts.
  • Projects that match your skills, and your CV never shared without your OK.

FAQ

Frequently asked questions

Who are the professionals?

Freelance engineers and technical consultants who run their own business. They work on a defined project, with agreed deliverables and duration, under a project or consulting contract.

Do you employ the professionals and assign them to us?

No. We don’t employ people to place them with other companies. We find independent professionals, assess their skills and introduce them to you for a specific project.

How quickly can a professional start?

Typically 2 to 3 weeks after the brief, depending on the profile and how specialised the skills are. Tell us your timeline in the brief, and we will say straight away whether we can meet it.

Which disciplines do you cover?

Software & IT, cybersecurity, and mechanical & industrial engineering, the same disciplines as our permanent searches.

Need engineers who contribute from day one?

Tell us about the role and the skills it needs, and we will come back with a plan for your search.
